## What it does
`dsh-plugin-bulkpublish` connects DeepSeek Harness (dsh) to the BulkPublish MCP server at `https://m
cp.bulkpublish.com`. Once it is installed, the model can draft, schedule, publish and analyse social
media posts, upload and browse media, and work through inbox conversations and post comments, all f
pload and browse media, and work through inbox conversations and post comments, all from a dsh chat.
The plugin's `apply(ctx, config)` loads DSH's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` as a child plugin wi
th a `streamable-http` transport. BulkPublish tools then appear to the model as `mcp__bulkpublish__<
treamable-http` transport. BulkPublish tools then appear to the model as `mcp__bulkpublish__<tool>`.
## Supported platforms (15)
Facebook · Instagram · X/Twitter · TikTok · YouTube · Threads · Bluesky · Pinterest · Google Busines
s Profile · LinkedIn · Mastodon · Discord · Telegram · Tumblr · Snapchat

1. Create a BulkPublish account at bulkpublish.com and connect the channels you want to post to.

`.

his package. If no key is set, the plugin logs a warning and registers no tools.

## Example prompts

- "List my connected channels and tell me which ones need reconnecting."
- "Draft a LinkedIn and X p

ost announcing our spring sale, and schedule it for the next free queue slot."

mple.com/banner.png and schedule an Instagram post with it for Friday at 10:00."

th's analytics broken down by platform."

the unread inbox conversations and draft replies for me to review."
## Tools
These are the 32 tools the BulkPublish MCP server returns from `tools/list`:
| Area | Tools |
| Posts | `create_post`, `update_post`, `get_post`, `list_posts`, `delete_post`, `publish_post`, `re

try_post`, `get_queue_slot` |
| Approval | `approve_post`, `reject_post` |
| Channels | `list_channe

ls`, `get_channel_options`, `update_channel` |
| Media | `upload_media`, `list_media`, `create_media

_upload`, `finalize_media_upload` |
| Labels | `list_labels` |
| Analytics | `get_analytics`, `get_p

ost_metrics` |
| Inbox | `list_conversations`, `get_conversation`, `reply_to_conversation`, `update_

conversation` |
| Comments | `list_post_comments`, `reply_to_comment`, `moderate_comment` |
| Intera
ctive views | `compose_post`, `view_posts`, `view_channels`, `view_media`, `view_analytics` |
